description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller class providing endpoints for greeting, documentation redirection, health check, and application information.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message indicating the service is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request URL scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the running application.
